newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African industrials end flat, golds uninspired.
newsitem.headline: S.African industrials end flat, golds uninspired.

text.p: South Africa's all-share index rose to a record closing high on Tuesday despite industrial shares being knocked off their highs by expectations of a weaker Wall Street opening.
The market started positive after Wall Street gained 143 points to a new record high on Monday night. But futures players combined with weaker S&P futures hit the industrial index.

Gold shares ended slightly firmer after bullion gained three dollars on Monday. But dealers said volumes were thin and players were concerned that the rise in the bullion price could not be sustained.
The all-share index 21.6 points stronger to a new high of 7,212.0 points, the industrial index was up 5.3 points to 8,568.7 points and the gold index added 6.6 points to 1,212.3 points.
